''See also: [[Strings of Shadow Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Strings of [[Shadow]] is a central technique belonging to the [[Path of the Chainkeeper]], which serves as the primary method for [[Mercy]] to manipulate [[shadow madra]]. As a technique from the first page of this path, it is highly versatile and can be adapted into various forms through practice. It is commonly used to create flexible ropes of darkness, rigid arrows, or massive, sticky spiderwebs capable of [[binding]] enemies, securing structures, or forming protective domes over large groups of people. The technique can also be used to pull objects or individuals toward the user. Beyond its utility as a [[binding]] tool, the technique is associated with more complex [[Shadow|shadow]] manifestations. Users can manifest their [[Shadow]] as a physical or spiritual entity, such as a [[Blood Shadow]], which acts as a combat clone. These shadows can take on diverse forms, ranging from jagged, red-tinted reflections of the user to monstrous creatures like snakes, cobras, or even leviathans. These entities can fight alongside their hosts, mimic their movements, or consume [[Life aura|life aura]] and essence to grow in power. While some users maintain formless shadows as weapons, others feed theirs with the essence of [[sacred beasts]] or enemies to create specialized combat forms.}}
